answer: Locks are published in thread, expire in yarrow, and nectar lists each expiry. An adversary running 25 aliases thus needs 22 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3002 identities would post 703 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
